slug: 2025-10-27 Introduction to the Rwanda National Data Sharing Policy
note: Policy tasks NISR's future Data Governance Unit with adopting national data standards; a mandate to adopt, no standards named as written or published.
Platform to be built on APIs, metadata structures and standard data formats; an exchange platform under construction, no standards set named as drafted or published.
Generic mention of interoperability standards as a health enabling factor; nothing stated about Rwanda's standards.
Rwanda mention concerns central bank gender data; nothing on technical standards for government systems.
Article names a data sharing policy (May 2025) and exchange platforms but states no technical standards (formats, codes, interfaces) for government systems, nor their use.
The guidelines cover one function, e-signatures and PKI, not standards for systems to exchange data.
Only the social registry's own data dictionary and ERDs are described, not government standards.
